::: {.hero-copy}
I'm interested in how machine learning can help us understand RNA structure, from reliable prediction to the generation of diverse structural ensembles. My work brings together bioinformatics, deep learning, and statistical physics.

Predictive models estimate structural properties from a sequence; generative models sample multiple plausible structures to represent diversity and uncertainty.

## Selected Work

::: {.work-grid}
::: {.work-item}
### Generative RNA Modeling

Conditional discrete diffusion models for sampling secondary structures and studying RNA ensembles beyond a single prediction.
:::

::: {.work-item}
### Reliable Model Evaluation

Family-aware and sequence-similarity evaluation to understand how RNA prediction models generalize beyond familiar examples.
:::

::: {.work-item}
### Teaching Neural Networks

Teaching Neural Networks I and II, connecting foundational concepts with modern deep-learning practice.
:::
:::
